subject: Regional Partner Summit: venue deposit & stipend authorization
messages:
From: Amy Parker <amy@blueridgeevents.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Regional Partner Summit — venue estimate & deposit

Hi Logan,

Thanks for confirming the dates for Nov 18-19. Attached is our latest estimate for the Grand Ballroom (venue_estimate_v2.pdf). Key points:
- Total event venue + A/V + basic staffing: $36,875
- Standard contract requires 50% deposit to secure weekend dates ($18,437.50)
- We can accept either invoice/PO or p-card for the deposit; net 30 on the balance.

A couple of notes we need from you to proceed:
1) Will finance need a PO number for the deposit, or can we take a p-card?
2) Do you want speaker/partner stipends handled as reimbursements or prepaid gift cards? I attached a simple stipend template to capture names/amounts.
3) Venue will need a current COI (certificate of insurance) before they sign. We can provide their requirements in a text file (insurance_certificate_request.txt).

If you want to avoid the 50% we can hold dates with a 40% deposit temporarily (we can issue a revised estimate).

Let me know how you want to proceed and who on your side will own the PO.

—Amy
Amy Parker
Blue Ridge Events

Thanks Amy — appreciate the quick turnaround and the flexibility. Looping in Marissa (events) and Ben (finance) to confirm payment path. A few quick asks for now:
- Can you provide an itemized line-by-line version (separate AV, security, F&B labor) so finance can code GLs?
- Please include cancellation and force majeure language that would apply to the deposit.
- If you can accept a PO, finance prefers that; Ben I’ve cc'd can confirm.

Marissa, Stephanie — can you confirm whether we want prepaid gift cards for partner stipends (fast, but creates reconciliation work) vs reimbursements? Marissa, you probably want the stipend list captured in the attached spreadsheet.

If we need to free up more spend, we may have to request a one-time cap exception — tagging Ben for process.

Thanks,
Logan

Logan — thanks for looping us in. Quick summary from events/ops:
- We need the venue to hold the date; the vendor is firm on the weekend which increases availability premium.
- Our current activation budget for the region is $25,000. The vendor estimate pushes us to ~$37k total (venue + basic AV + labor).
- Recommend we do: 40% deposit to hold dates (revised estimate), and Redwood covers the remaining deposit out of a one-time advance/PO.

Stipends: Recommend prepaid $150 e-gift cards for 20 partner presenters (total ~$3,000). This is easier for partners and low admin; finance will still need a reconciliation template (I attached attendee-stipend-template.xlsx).

Cost center proposal: 4201-Marketing:Events is the primary GL. If we split sponsorship vs activation, we can route partner stipends to 4302-PartnerPrograms. Please confirm with finance.

Action items for finance:
- Ben: can you provision a one-time PO/advance for $15k (to cover the deposit shortfall) and confirm GL codes?
- Also confirm whether the deposit can be paid by p-card under the current card limit or needs an invoice + PO.

Thanks — Marissa

[attachment: attendee-stipend-template.xlsx (XLSX, 12 KB)]

Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 11:10:00 -07:00

Marissa/Logan — I can support a one-time PO for $15,000 as an advance pending formal justification. Need the following to move forward:
1) Final line-item estimate (itemized AV, security, F&B labor) so we can map to GL lines.
2) Short business justification (1–2 paragraphs) signed off by Marketing manager (Marissa).
3) Confirmation whether the vendor will accept an invoice referencing a PO or requires p-card for deposit.

If you can provide those by EOD Wednesday I’ll route the approval. Also confirm whether any portion should be split to 4302-PartnerPrograms (stipends) vs 4201-Marketing.

Ben
Finance — Redwood Inference
